title: My Hobby
description: Practise present perfect, like + -ing and frequency words, then write about your hobby.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🎨 My hobby is painting. I love ___ pictures of animals.
exercises.explanation: After "love" we can use the verb + -ing: love drawing.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: I have ___ (play) the guitar for two years.
exercises.explanation: Present perfect = have + past participle: have played.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + usually + verb: I usually practise after school.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week: on Saturdays.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: My brother does not like swimming.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it we use "doesn't".

exercises.prompt: Write for or since.
exercises.text: ⚽ Minh has played football ___ he was five.
exercises.explanation: Use "since" with a starting point in time.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My coach is a woman ___ teaches us to swim.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" for people.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: How long have you played the piano.
exercises.explanation: How long + have + subject + past participle: How long have you played the piano?

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Playing the guitar is ___ than playing the drums.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives take -er: quieter.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word SINCE. Begin: "I ..."
exercises.text: I started collecting stamps in 2022 and I still collect them.
answers: I have been collecting stamps since 2022.
exercises.explanation: Use "since" with a starting point: since 2022.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: 📚 Last week I ___ (read) three books about space.
exercises.explanation: "Read" has the same spelling in the past, but we say "red".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Yesterday I maked a model plane with my dad.
answers: Yesterday I made a model plane with my dad.
exercises.explanation: "Make" is irregular. The past simple is "made".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I am sure that I ___ win the next match.
exercises.explanation: Use "will" for a prediction.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: You should try to practise every day.
exercises.explanation: You should try to practise every day.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: If I practise a lot, I ___ better.
exercises.explanation: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb.

exercises.prompt: Write in, on or at.
exercises.text: 🏊 I go swimming ___ the weekend with my sister.
exercises.explanation: In English we say "at the weekend" (or "on the weekend").

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word GOING. Begin: "Next ..."
exercises.text: My plan is to join the chess club next year.
answers: Next year I am going to join the chess club.
Next year I'm going to join the chess club.
exercises.explanation: "Going to" talks about plans.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Dancing is more fun that watching TV.
answers: Dancing is more fun than watching TV.
exercises.explanation: We use "than" to compare things.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: You ___ wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
exercises.explanation: "Must" means it is very important.

exercises.prompt: Write because, so or but.
exercises.text: 🎸 I want to be in a band, ___ I practise the guitar every day.
exercises.explanation: "So" shows the result.

task.prompt: Write about your hobby. Tell a new friend about it.
contentPoints: Say how long you have done it.
Say when and where you do it.
task.modelAnswer: My hobby is playing football. I have played it for three years. I usually play with my friends in the park on Saturday morning. My coach, who is very kind, teaches us new skills. I like it because it is fun and it keeps me healthy. If I practise a lot, I will be a better player. Next year I am going to join the school team.
